g.text: All 42 ways to rank a 3 x 3 grid: 36 can be stable splits, 6 never can

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #9aa4ae

g.text: Energies ranked 1 (lowest) to 9 and seated in a grid so that every row and column increases. A ranking can be stable only if

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #9aa4ae

g.text: some "row number + column number" puts the cells in the same order; for 6 grids no numbers can, and a short certificate proves it.
